messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)

Todd, order Shop····, your Nexus S1, was delivered on November 10. It shipped from our Chattanooga warehouse on November 5.

Tracking: (tracking link hidden)

If the box isn't there, tell me and I'll look into it.
I received it but I found this price on same product.
Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Handed to the team · This is a competitor price-match request, which only a person can decide. The di

I'm glad the S1 arrived, Todd. Thanks for sending the screenshot of the bitcoinmerch.com price.

A price match against another store isn't something I can decide myself, so I've passed it to the team with your order and the screenshot. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email with an answer. I can't promise how it will turn out.

Is the S1 up and hashing for you?
Yep, up and running with more efficiency then my other 3 even operations at a faster hashrate

That's good to hear. A new S1 running more efficiently than your other three at a higher hashrate is what we'd hope for.

The price question is with the team, and the answer will come to your email. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Will batch 1 of Magic M. 40 T still ship Nov 14

Todd, the 40T no longer ships in batches. All 300 units were built together and are shipping together, and Magic M. expects them to leave the factory today, November 12. That's from our emails of November 3 and 8. Please check your spam folder if you didn't see them.

Your order Shop···· covers the 40T, the Miner D. and the Power K., all in one box. We'll email you tracking as soon as it ships to you. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Before you go, one thing: you sent an S1 back in the summer, so what made you pick another one this month?

You stopped Todd, the S1 delivered on Nov 10 is fine. Two things are still open:

- **Price match:** I passed Todd's bitcoinmerch.com screenshot ($528 Black Friday price on the same Nexus S1) to the team as a money flag, and told him the answer will come by email. I promised him nothing. The dispute check flagged a lost chargeback on his older order Shop····, so the price match is a call for you, not me. I didn't mention that to him.
- **Magic M. 40T (Shop····):** he asked whether it ships Nov 14. I told him it doesn't ship in batches any more, the factory expects to send all units out today (Nov 12), and he'll get tracking by email. The order itself still says Nov 30. I followed the Nov 3 rule and didn't give him that date.

Because the price match is still open, I didn't ask him for a review.

You too, Todd. Sorry, my last message had a note meant for our team pasted under my question. Please ignore it.

The team has your price question and will answer it by email. We'll email you tracking for your 40T as soon as it ships to you.
